title: Yellow Spiced Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: Salty, juicy, and light, these Saudi Arabian lamb kebabs feature ground cardamom and wok-hei for a unique flavor profile, making them a low-calorie-friendly option for a quick dinner.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, ground cardamom, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, mixing well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
While the kebabs are cooking, mix the lemon juice and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
Once the kebabs are done, brush them with the lemon juice mixture and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or quinoa.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
